The unpopulated eastern end of [[Shing Jea Island]] has long been considered a sacred place by the people of the [[Cantha]].

{{Quotation|game|
The valley of '''Zen Daijun''' has long been a holy place to the people of Cantha and a destination for pilgrims seeking enlightenment on [[Shing Jea Island]]. It is the home of [[Zunraa]], an ancient protector that takes the form of a [[Kirin]]. Many weary travelers have been buoyed by the restorative properties of Zunraa's ancient shrines, which still stand to this day.
}}

==Getting there==
* The [[primary quest]] [[To Zen Daijun]] grants access, but any foreign characters who have not completed [[Minister Cho's Estate]] will be left behind in [[Haiju Lagoon]].
* Non-[[Factions]] characters will need to travel northeast across [[Jaya Bluffs]] and then southeast through Haiju Lagoon to find this [[mission outpost]]. If the party contains any Factions characters that have not completed To Zen Daijun (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Haiju Lagoon will be closed.
* Access through [[Zen Daijun (explorable area)]] is unavailable because [[Guard Lae Fao]] will not grant access if the party contains any characters that have not completed Zen Daijun.
